release_source_equivalence.change: The release commit adds five lines under [tool.ruff], setting target-version to py310 with explanatory comments. There are no deletions. Every other root entry and every source subtree is identical.
release_source_equivalence.scope: Only this exact official wheel SHA256/build commit and this exact inventory release commit. This is source equivalence for the recorded lint-only release change, not identity of the two Git commits or an allowance for other builds.

Adam_family_updated_parameter_and_state_.source: Unchanged existing session oracle default policy, fixed before execution.

compatibility_limits: Native explicit optimizer-state Tensor lifetime and scalar step input remain distinct from Torch Optimizer-owned state.
Momentum first-step state Version differences are recorded, not reset or hidden; these observations are not merged with the earlier separate 283-state counter gap.
Partial-case vector mutation is an explicitly disclosed single-frame data_alias/write/bump/drop construction; it is not a native Tensor.add_ implementation.
No grad=None clearing operation, nonleaf retain_grad or .grad Tensor-object version API is qualified.
